Its final resolution says it was addressed with FHIR-15125 and FHIR-14452.

The relevant historical application appears to be git commit 7b2b645120, which mentions GF#15125 and GF#14452 and added the ImagingStudy workflow-alignment changes in the spreadsheet-era source, including status, reasonCode/reasonReference, note, and series performer/function/actor support.
additional_context: ImagingStudy is active in source/fhir.ini. Current structuredefinition-ImagingStudy.xml contains ImagingStudy.status mapped to Event.status, basedOn mapped to Event.basedOn, procedure mapped to Event.partOf, reason as CodeableReference mapped to Event.reason, note mapped to Event.note, and series.performer/function/actor mapped to Event.performer/function/actor. Current search parameters include based-on, performer, reason-concept, reason-reference, referrer, status, and procedure. Later issues refined status guidance and reason search parameters, and the current Event mapping exception intentionally lists Event.statusReason as not relevant.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current active source already preserves the approved FHIR-10350 semantics; restoring a separate statusReason element for this seed would conflict with the current mapping exception and the seed comment that notDone/notDoneReason belong in Procedure rather than ImagingStudy.
